title: Exponential intersection tails for loop-erased random walk
exact_target: Determine whether infinite loop-erased random walks have exponentially small probabilities of sharing many edges.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 10000020 (AMR-099-0020). CC BY 4.0.

Itai Benjamini, \emph{Coarse Geometry and Randomness}, Saint-Flour lecture notes, version dated 30 October 2013; original author manuscript preserved in Arquivo.pt capture of 31 December 2020, Definition 4.16 and Open Problem 4.22, pp. 35--36.
